name: High Relief
description: Deeper, more dramatic projection. Edges may cast shadows. Pushes heightmaps to the limit of depth range.
carving_traits: Needs strong void separation between elements
Can require longer carve times and deeper passes
Emphasizes volumetric depth over surface detail
machinability_prompt: Render as a grayscale heightmap with deep sculptural contrast. Lighter grays are raised, darker grays are deeply recessed. Avoid ambient occlusion, lighting gradients, or textured shading.
